job_description:
AI Systems Engineer (d/f/m)
mobile.de • Berlin, Berlin, Germany (Hybrid)

- Agentic platform engineering: Hands-on experience designing, developing, and operating agentic systems using frameworks such as AWS AgentCore, Google Vertex AI, Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar.
- Cloud-native development: Proficient in AWS infrastructure (VPC, Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) or their Google Cloud Platform equivalents, with experience in cross-account integrations, Terraform, and Kubernetes.
- Programming expertise: Strong coding skills in Python and/or Java, with a track record of building production-grade backend services and APIs.
- System integration: Experience integrating agents with microservices, recommendation engines, and vector databases (e.g., S3 Vector, OpenSearch), ideally in a multi-environment setup.
- Observability, evaluation and compliance: Familiarity with implementing observability, evaluation frameworks (for agents and prompts), runtime guardrails, and compliance controls for AI/agentic workflows.
- FinOps: Ability to provide reliable cost estimations and ensure effective cost controls
- AI adoption and literacy: Demonstrated use of AI-powered development tools (e.g., code assistants, automated testing), and a commitment to responsible and innovative AI adoption.
- Prompt engineering: Demonstrated ability to design, refine, and optimize prompts for large language models and agentic workflows, including multi-step reasoning, tool use, and robust handling of ambiguous or incomplete user input.
- Bonus: Experience with RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), knowledge base design, and secure, scalable agentic product deployments in regulated environments.

Job responsibilities

- Design, build, and evolve agentic platforms: Architect and implement robust, scalable agent-based systems on AWS AgentCore & Bedrock and/or Google Vertex AI Agent Engine, and modern cloud-native infrastructure.
- Drive AI-first engineering: Champion the adoption of agentic and generative AI technologies across the product lifecycle, leveraging frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph for tool orchestration and intelligent workflow automation.
- Integrate and optimize multi-system workflows: Develop and maintain integrations between agentic platforms, K8s services (via MCP Server), and recommendation engines, ensuring secure, efficient, and observable cross-environment operations.
- Enable secure, compliant, and observable AI: Embed strong runtime policy enforcement, guardrails, and observability into agentic workflows—ensuring compliance with regulatory, privacy, and ethical standards (including the EU AI Act).
- Own end-to-end delivery: Lead the full lifecycle of agentic solutions, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment and monitoring, with a strong focus on measurable impact and continuous improvement.
- Collaborate and inspire: Work closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Platform, Legal, Privacy) to deliver value and foster a culture of AI literacy, knowledge sharing, and responsible innovation.
- Stay ahead of the curve: Continuously scout, evaluate, and introduce new agentic and AI technologies, sharing best practices and mentoring peers to accelerate company-wide AI adoption.
